description: Source code implementing control functions for the LifeVibes audio module, including parameter setting, getting, and callback handling.

methods.name: LVM_SetControlParameters
methods.description: Sets or updates the control parameters for the LifeVibes module, with validation and copying of parameters.

methods.name: LVM_GetControlParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current control parameters from the module.

methods.name: LVM_SetTrebleBoost
methods.description: Enables and configures the treble boost effect based on parameters and sample rate.

methods.name: LVM_SetVolume
methods.description: Converts volume from dB to linear scale and applies it to the mixer.

methods.name: LVM_SetHeadroom
methods.description: Calculates and sets appropriate headroom based on EQ settings.

methods.name: LVM_ApplyNewSettings
methods.description: Applies all pending parameter changes to the various audio modules, updating configurations accordingly.

methods.name: LVM_AlgoCallBack
methods.description: Callback function for algorithm state changes, such as module off events.

methods.name: LVM_VCCallBack
methods.description: Callback for volume control updates, stops volume mixer when target is reached.
